dialogues.speaker: Farrokhzadan Journal (II)
dialogues.text: "...As expected, Lunja's terrible luck poured months' worth of payments into the game..."

dialogues.speaker: Farrokhzadan Journal (II)
dialogues.text: "...We practically lost our shirt! Those cheats from Golden Mouse drove us out. We had to come here to camp first..."

dialogues.speaker: Farrokhzadan Journal (II)
dialogues.text: "...The air was damp and the fuel for our weapons was running low, but Lunja was cheerful as usual and said she smelled big business..."

dialogues.speaker: Farrokhzadan Journal (II)
dialogues.text: "...Ziri was there weeping since the gold axe he ordered was ruined. His relationship with Ahangar's foster daughter was probably doomed as well. I had to give him a punch in the face to stop the wailing..."
